blocks.text: The daily reality for insurance underwriters

Your day likely starts with a flood of broker emails. Each one requires triage, data extraction, and entry into your underwriting workbench. This administrative burden distracts from core risk analysis. Many underwriters find that manual filing and searching for attachments eat into their capacity to quote new business.

Speed matters when you manage hundreds of emails. Use these built in shortcuts to stay in the flow. Press ⌘ + 1 to jump to your Mail view. Use ⌘ + 2 for your Calendar. Switch to Contacts with ⌘ + 3. These simple moves save seconds that add up to minutes by the end of the day.
If a shortcut does not work, check System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > App Shortcuts. You can manually assign keys to any menu command that appears in the Outlook menu bar.
blocks.title: Customizing shortcuts

blocks.text: Brokers send documents in many formats. You often need to move these into Guidewire or Applied Epic. Do not drag and drop if you can avoid it. Use the Outlook search bar to find specific file types. Press ⌘ + ⌥ + F to focus the search field instantly. If you lose track of where a setting is, hold ⌥ + ⌘ and ask Lazur to point at it.

Data re-keying is the biggest productivity killer. When you receive a submission, do not just open the attachment. Use a structured process to extract key data points. If you use AI tools to parse emails, keep your Outlook folder structure clean. This helps the tools find what they need. Create folders by broker or by policy type to keep your inbox organized.

items: Create a folder for each major broker account.
Use rules to move incoming submissions to specific folders automatically.
Archive old emails to keep your search index fast.
Pin important requests using the pin icon in the message list.
Set reminders on emails that require a follow up with a broker.

blocks.text: Your Mac is a powerful tool for insurance work. Ensure you are on the latest version of macOS to keep Outlook running smoothly. Microsoft requires macOS 14 or later for the latest features. Keep your underwriting workbench updated in your browser. If you use Chrome, ensure the Lazur extension is active to help with research tasks.
Staying organized with calendar and tasks

Underwriting involves constant coordination. Sync your calendar with your email to track broker meetings. Use the drag and drop method to turn an email into a calendar event. Select the email and drop it onto the calendar icon in the sidebar. This creates a new event with the email subject as the title.

items: Keeping too many emails in the primary inbox.
Ignoring the power of search filters in Outlook.
Failing to use templates for common broker inquiries.
Opening attachments directly without saving them to a secure location.
Not using the focused inbox to separate high priority submissions.

blocks.text: You can use Lazur to help you draft responses faster. Hold the fn key and dictate your reply. Lazur handles the formatting, leaving you to focus on the content of your message. This is useful for standard responses where you need to request missing information from a broker.
When to reach out for help

If you struggle with specific Outlook features, use the help menu. If the menu is too complex, ask Lazur to explain it. Lazur can walk you through complex steps one at a time. It will wait for you to perform each action. This is safer than letting a bot click around your sensitive data.

The industry is moving toward more automated intake. Prepare your workflow now. Standardize your naming conventions for files. Clean up your contact lists. Use native Mac features like tags to label files in Finder. These small habits make it easier to adopt new AI tools as they become available for your specific underwriting workbench.

faq.question: How can I find where a setting moved in the new Outlook for Mac?
faq.answer: Hold ⌥ + ⌘ and ask Lazur to point at the setting. It will draw a circle around the button or menu item on your screen.

faq.question: Does Lazur click buttons for me in Outlook?
faq.answer: No. Lazur points at items and guides you through processes, but it does not click, edit, or operate apps for you.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur to draft email responses?
faq.answer: Yes. Hold the fn key to dictate your response. Lazur will format the text directly into your email at the cursor.

faq.question: Is my data safe when using Lazur?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur only sees your screen and listens while you hold the shortcut. Audio and screenshots are not stored or used to train AI models.
